test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Khan lends an amount of ₹10,000 to Irfan at 10% per annum compound interest for 5 years, compounded annually. What is the compound interest accrued for the 4th year?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 10000

Rate of interest = 10%

Time = 5 years

**Concept used:**

Amount = P(1 + r/100)t

Here,

P = Principal or sum

r = rate%

t = time

Interest = Amount - P

**Calculation:**

Interest for the 4th year = Amount of 4 years - Amount of 3 years

So,

10000(1 + 10/100)⁴ - 10000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 10000(1 + 1/10)4 - 10000(1 + 1/10)3

⇒ 10000(11/10)4 - 10000(11/10)3

⇒ 10000 × 14641/10000 - 10000 × 1331/1000

⇒ 14641 - 13310

⇒ 1331

So, the interest of the 4th year = Rs. 1331

**∴ The compound interest accrued for the 4th year is Rs. 1331.**
